title: MIDAS REAL-SOURCE QUALITY AND LABEL-FEASIBILITY CAMPAIGN — 48H-002

research.primary_hypothesis: An independent replay of a frozen recent real-source window can reproduce quality, strict freshness, fee, and candidate gates; the same captured stream may not contain settled outcome or execution labels.

adaptive_rules.candidate: Independently audit every new completed scan; require strict freshness before elevating any positive candidate.
adaptive_rules.implementation_mismatch: If independent fee or stored-versus-replayed validity/edge mismatches appear, extend the frozen audit by the preceding 32 scans.
adaptive_rules.freshness_bottleneck: If fewer than 20% of independent quality-valid observations pass the conservative timestamp gate, extend the audit by the preceding 32 scans.
adaptive_rules.no_candidate: If no strict-fresh candidate appears after 12 hours, shift priority to prospective source-quality and outcome/fill-label feasibility; do not train on synthetic targets.
